acceptance.1_secrets_wired: DEV_OPENCLAW_OPENAI_API_KEY and _2 are passed in every workflow step that already passes the Anthropic key (deploy, restore, same-final return, compensation, dev-artifact) and in the isolated L12 step; scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh forwards them via command_prefix and the compose export; no dispatch input added. Test: test_openai_api_route_secrets_reach_every_deploy_path_without_dispatch_input.
acceptance.2_non_ambient_names: docker-compose.yml gateway env OPENCLAW_API_ROUTE_KEY_1/_2 only. Test: test_api_keys_use_non_ambient_names_never_openai_api_key (no OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY in compose, deploy script, workflow, configure script).
acceptance.3_missing_key: compose default is empty; configure step unsets the provider and drops its default-chain refs. Test: test_missing_or_empty_api_key_drops_its_route_and_gateway_still_configures.
acceptance.4_distinct_ids: providers openai-api and openai-api-2; built-in openai untouched. Test: test_api_route_registers_one_provider_per_key_with_env_secretref.
acceptance.5_env_ref_only: apiKey = {source: env, provider: default, id: OPENCLAW_API_ROUTE_KEY_n}; tests assert sentinel key values never appear in argv, stdout, stderr or batch.
acceptance.6_mechanism: one provider id per key with model-level fallback in agents.defaults.model.fallbacks (pinned image 2026.7.1, coordinator-proven: 401 -> reason=auth -> next candidate).
acceptance.7_chain_order: DEFAULT_MODEL_CHAIN: anthropic, openai-api, openai-api-2, openai/gpt-5.6-sol, openai/gpt-5.5; structured-extraction and memory-index copy it. Test: test_default_chain_orders_api_route_after_anthropic_and_before_subscription.
acceptance.8_four_cases_on_pinned_image: PENDING: needs the pinned gateway image and live keys; not run in this worker (no docker/keys). Unit-level contract tests only. To be shown by coordinator/hosted reading.
acceptance.9_isolated_bootstrap: render_batch adds both providers when PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_OPENAI_API_KEY[_2] present and drops refs when absent. Tests in scripts/test_openclaw_isolated_model_bootstrap.py.
acceptance.10_governance_and_spend: governance.md 2026-11-18 entry records the decision and per-token billing. Expected calls/day on this route at hosted scale: observed ~88 answered turns/day (615 over 7 days) plus up to 500 memory-bridge calls/day once its switch is on, i.e. about 90/day now and at most ~590/day. Because Anthropic is first in the chain, the route only receives the share Anthropic refuses; the figures are the upper bound if it refuses everything.
acceptance.11_no_recurring_job: no job or persistent writer added; the keys are read from the container environment.
acceptance.12_hosted_reading: PENDING: coordinator reads hosted gateway session files after a release carrying this is served; not reported beyond deployed before then.
